evals.prompt: 基于已有 series.md/characters.md，给 ep002 做一个 60 秒 episode card，要有反转。
evals.expected_output: Writes lean episode-card.md with hook, conflict, escalation, reversal, ending handoff.

evals.prompt: 下一集发生啥你定一下，别写完整剧本。
evals.expected_output: Creates a concise intent card only.

evals.prompt: 没有 characters.md，但我想写 ep001 卡片。
evals.expected_output: Stops and hands off to series bible.
expectations: Does not invent core character bible

evals.prompt: 这集我想要完整 script.md 和 storyboard.md，你先直接生成吧。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes full script/storyboard as outside default MVP and asks/flags scope before expanding.
expectations: Does not silently create mandatory script.md/storyboard.md
